# STX Downloader

> STX Downloader is an open-source Windows app, MIT licensed, published by Strategia-X (Rocky Elsalaymeh). It saves media you are allowed to keep, from YouTube and from web pages, tells you what the audio really is, and plays your whole collection with VLC's engine. DRM-protected media is out of scope: STX neither saves nor plays it.

Current version: 1.2.0, released 2026-11-15. Runs on Windows 10 version 2004 or later, x64. Support: support@strategia-x.com

- [Full reference for language models](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/llms-full.txt): every feature, install, requirements and what has been tested
